value.title: La bohème
value.snippet: La bohème (/ˌlɑː boʊˈɛm/ LAH boh-EM, Italian: [la boˈɛm]) is an opera in four acts, composed by Giacomo Puccini between 1893 and 1895 to an Italian libretto

value.title: La fanciulla del West
value.snippet: La fanciulla del West (The Damsel of the West) is an opera in three acts by Giacomo Puccini to an Italian libretto by Guelfo Civinini and Carlo Zangarini

value.title: Manon Lescaut (Puccini)

value.title: La bohème (Leoncavallo)
value.snippet: successful premiere at the Teatro la Fenice, Venice, on 6 May 1897. Leoncavallo wrote his opera La bohème contemporaneously with Giacomo Puccini's own treatment

value.title: La rondine
value.snippet: La rondine (The Swallow) is an opera in three acts by Giacomo Puccini to an Italian libretto by Giuseppe Adami, based on a libretto by Alfred Maria Willner
